detail.longDescription: 🦖 <feOffset> ✅ Widely available (from Jul 2015) https:// developer.mozilla.org/en-US/do cs/Web/SVG/Reference/Element/feOffset The <feOffset> SVG filter primitive enables offsetting an input image relative to its current position. The input image as a whole is offset by the values specified in the dx and dy attributes. # webdev # SVG
